full_prompt_en: A playful editorial illustration shows a smiling man in a dark suit striding left beside a black dog against a warm ivory ground. A tall golden-yellow shape with a rounded upper edge rises behind the pair on the left, while a second curved yellow ribbon winds through the centre and descends toward the lower right. Near the upper centre, the man's narrow pale face has a long pointed nose, one large outlined eye and a broad crescent smile. A black brimmed hat sits above dark swept hair. His white shirt and bright red, arrow-like tie separate the dark jacket lapels. One arm bends across the front of his body, while the other projects to the right and then turns downward at the elbow; the pale hand rests over an orange-red open book with white page shapes and bold black marks. His long, sharply bent trouser legs extend toward the lower left in a running stride. Across the lower-left half, the dog bounds in the same direction, with a long grey muzzle, pointed ears, a red-orange collar and a curved red tongue visible inside its open mouth. Its thin legs stretch outward and its tail curves up behind the overlapping figure. Above the man's right shoulder, an orange rounded tab and a fan of small red-orange wedges punctuate the blank ground. Fine charcoal-like grain shades the black and grey forms, while yellow, red and ivory areas remain flatter and brighter. The lighting is graphic and even, with depth conveyed through overlapping silhouettes and internal tonal gradients rather than a cast ground shadow. The overall composition interlocks angular limbs, sweeping yellow curves and a lively pair of left-facing profiles in a compact, high-contrast arrangement.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅轻快的编辑插画表现一位微笑的深色西装男子与黑狗一起向左迈步，背景为暖象牙白。在两者左后方，一块顶部圆弧的高金黄色形体向上伸展，另一条弯曲黄带穿过中央并落向右下。上方中央附近，男子窄浅色脸庞带有长尖鼻、一只大型勾线眼睛和宽弯月形笑容，黑色有檐帽压在向后梳的深发上。白衬衣和鲜红箭头状领带分开深色外套翻领。一条手臂弯过身前，另一条伸向右方后在肘部向下折转；浅色手掌搭在橙红摊开书本上，书中有白色页形和醒目黑痕。修长、明显弯折的裤腿向左下方伸出，形成奔跑步态。左下半部黑狗朝同方向跃起，长灰口鼻、尖耳、红橙项圈及张口中的弯红舌头都清楚可见。细腿向外伸展，尾巴在与人物交叠的后方向上弯曲。男子右肩上方，橙色圆顶小块和扇状散开的红橙楔形点缀空白底。细炭笔般颗粒刻画黑灰形体明暗，黄色、红色与象牙白区域更平坦明亮。照明图形化而均匀，纵深来自剪影相叠和内部调性渐变，而非地面投影。整体构图让折角四肢、流动黄弧和一对活跃的朝左侧脸彼此扣合，形成紧凑而高反差的布局。
style_prompt_en: The visual language combines flat colour blocks, angular cutouts and sparse linear marks. Large warm fields press against black shapes, while cream gaps provide pauses that keep the dense arrangement readable. Edges are mostly crisp, with occasional grain and small irregular marks adding a printed, handmade surface. The palette is limited but high in contrast: yellow and orange carry brightness, black anchors the structure, and pale neutrals open space. Illumination is even and graphic rather than modelled through realistic shadows. The composition relies on overlap, asymmetry and scale shifts to create movement within a compact frame.
style_prompt_zh: 整体视觉语言结合平涂色块、斜角切形与稀疏线性标记。大片暖色形状与黑色形体相互挤压，奶油色间隙则形成停顿，使密集布局仍然清晰。边缘大多利落，偶尔出现的颗粒和不规则小痕迹带来印刷般的手作表面。配色有限而反差鲜明：黄与橙负责明亮感，黑色稳住结构，浅色中性色打开空间。光线均匀且具有图形感，不依靠写实投影来塑形。构图通过叠压、不对称和尺度变化，在紧凑画面中形成动势。
theme_en: A smiling suited man and a black dog stride left through bold yellow and orange graphic shapes
theme_zh: 微笑的西装男子与黑狗向左迈步，穿行在醒目的黄橙图形之间
name: 留白拼贴编辑插画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
